name: OI-price divergence — fast short-covering pop fade (price up + OI down + range top, short, 1h)
rationale: MECHANISM: the short-covering-rally fade read on a fast 1h clock and gated by range_position instead of ADX. A positive 1h return (price up) while open_interest contracts (OI down) is a pop fuelled by shorts closing, not new longs; requiring range_position near the top of the recent range isolates local exhaustion where the unconfirmed pop is most likely to fail. We short (direction -1) the unconfirmed move for a fast ~0.08-0.25d reversion. Distinct from variant 10: 1h clock, range_position gate (a distance-in-range read, not a trend-strength read), and a much shorter hold. DISCONFIRMER 1: kill if 1h OI is too noisy/reset-prone to make the divergence sign reliable — a PIT-honest single-venue OI series is required. DISCONFIRMER 2: kill if the fast fade does not beat same-bar continuation, or if net-of-fee edge dies once real 6bps taker fees hit the elevated 1h turnover.
catalyst: 1h price pop with falling open interest at the range top — an unconfirmed short-covering pop to fade short.
